28:14.text: And when he attained his full strength, and was perfect
(Prophethood and right judgement of the affairs)
[of the religion of his forefathers i.e. Islâmic Monotheism]
. And thus do We reward the Muhsinûn
(i.e. good doers. See the footnote of V.9:120)

28:15.text: And he entered the city at a time of unawareness of its people: and he found there two men fighting, - one of his party
(his religion - from the Children of Israel)
, and the other of his foes. The man of his
party asked him for help against his foe, so Mûsâ
struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: "This is of Shaitan’s
doing: verily, he is a plain misleading enemy."

28:16.text: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, so forgive me." Then He forgave him. Verily, He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

28:17.text: He said: "My Lord! For that with which You have favoured me, I will never more be a helper of the Mujrimûn

28:18.text: So he became afraid, looking about in the city
(waiting as to what will be the result of his crime of killing)
, when behold, the man who had sought his help the day before, called for his help
said to him: "Verily, you are a plain misleader!"

28:19.text: Then when he decided to seize the man who was an enemy to both of them, the man said: "O Mûsâ
! Is it your intention to kill me as you killed a man yesterday? Your aim is nothing but to become a tyrant in the land, and not to be one of those who do right."

28:20.text: And there came a man running, from the farthest end of the city. He said: "O Mûsâ
! Verily, the chiefs are taking counsel together about you, to kill you, so escape. Truly, I am one of the good advisers to you."

28:21.text: So he escaped from there, looking about in a state of fear. He said: "My Lord! Save me from the people who are Zâlimûn
